# Peptidux

> Peptidux supplies high-purity lyophilized research peptides and laboratory materials to qualified researchers, with independent HPLC purity testing and batch certificates of analysis.

## Products

- [Semaglutide](https://de.peptidux.com/glp-1/semaglutide/): GLP-1 receptor agonist research peptide (31-amino-acid analogue of GLP-1), >99% purity, 5mg presentation.
- [Tirzepatide](https://de.peptidux.com/glp-1/tirzepatide/): Dual GIP/GLP-1 receptor agonist research peptide, >99% purity, 5mg presentation.
- [Retatrutide](https://de.peptidux.com/glp-1/retatrutide/): Triple GIP/GLP-1/glucagon receptor agonist research peptide, >99% purity.
- [BPC-157](https://de.peptidux.com/recovery/bpc-157/): 15-amino-acid research peptide studied in tissue repair and recovery, >99% purity.
- [TB-500](https://de.peptidux.com/recovery/tb-500/): Synthetic thymosin beta-4 region peptide for tissue repair research, >99% purity.
- [GHK-Cu](https://de.peptidux.com/recovery/ghk-cu/): Copper-binding tripeptide for tissue and skin research, >99% purity.
- [NAD+](https://de.peptidux.com/longevity/nad-plus/): Coenzyme studied in cellular energy metabolism and aging research, >99% purity.
- [Epitalon](https://de.peptidux.com/longevity/epitalon/): Tetrapeptide studied in biological rhythm and aging research, >99% purity.
- [MOTS-c](https://de.peptidux.com/longevity/mots-c/): Mitochondrial-derived peptide studied in cellular metabolism research, >99% purity.
- [HGH 10IU](https://de.peptidux.com/hgh/hgh-10iu/): Human growth hormone research peptide, 10 IU presentation, >99% purity.
- [Ipamorelin](https://de.peptidux.com/hgh/ipamorelin/): Growth hormone secretagogue research peptide, >99% purity.
- [CJC-1295](https://de.peptidux.com/hgh/cjc-1295/): GHRH analogue research peptide, >99% purity.
- [SS-31](https://de.peptidux.com/longevity/ss-31/): Small synthetic peptide targeting the inner mitochondrial membrane, ~640 g/mol.
- [Humanin](https://de.peptidux.com/longevity/humanin/): 24-amino-acid mitochondrial-derived peptide, ~2.7 kDa.
- [Testosterone Cypionate](https://de.peptidux.com/steroids/testosterone-cypionate/): Long-chain ester of testosterone for androgen research, ~412.6 g/mol.

## Categories

- [GLP-1 Peptides](https://de.peptidux.com/glp-1/): Semaglutide, tirzepatide, retatrutide and other GLP-1 receptor agonists for metabolic research.
- [Recovery Peptides](https://de.peptidux.com/recovery/): BPC-157, TB-500, GHK-Cu and related compounds for tissue repair research.
- [Longevity Peptides](https://de.peptidux.com/longevity/): NAD+, epitalon, MOTS-c and related compounds for aging and cellular health research.
- [HGH & Secretagogues](https://de.peptidux.com/hgh/): HGH, ipamorelin, CJC-1295 and related peptides for growth hormone research.
- [Steroids](https://de.peptidux.com/steroids/): Research anabolic-androgenic compounds for laboratory investigation.
- [Metabolic Peptides](https://de.peptidux.com/metabolic/): L-carnitine and other compounds for metabolic research.
- [Laboratory Supplies](https://de.peptidux.com/supplies/): Benzyl alcohol, bacteriostatic water, vitamins and research-grade reagents.

## Key Facts

- Supplier of high-purity lyophilized research peptides and laboratory materials.
- Every batch is independently tested by high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC).
- A certificate of analysis (CoA) is supplied with every batch, documenting purity and peptide content.
- Products are for laboratory research use only; not for human or veterinary consumption.
- Site is intended for adults aged 18 and over.
